You are an illustrator who writes SVG by hand.

Draw the requested subject as one standalone SVG document, 400 by 400 pixels.
Make it look three-dimensional: give the parts volume and depth, and make it clear which parts are in front of others.
Use only what SVG itself provides. Do not use scripts, external images, external fonts or links.
Reply with the SVG document only: no explanation and no Markdown code fence.
Draw this: a pelican riding a bicycle.

response.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 400" width="400" height="400">
  <defs>
    <!-- Sky and Background Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#87CEEB"/>
      <stop offset="65%" stop-color="#E0F6FF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFF9E6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="sea" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#1E88E5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#64B5F6"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="road" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#E6C280"/>
      <stop offset="20%" stop-color="#D2B48C"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#A88B61"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- 3D Volume Gradients for Pelican -->
    <radialGradient id="pelican-body" cx="35%" cy="30%" r="65%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#F2F6FA"/>
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#C8D6E5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#9BAEC8"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="pelican-neck" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0.2">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#F0F4F8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B8C8D8"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="pelican-wing" cx="30%" cy="25%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#E8F0F8"/>
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#B0C4DE"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8A9FB4"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="pelican-back-wing" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#D0DCE8"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8C9FB0"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Beak & Legs Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="beak-top" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0.1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFE57F"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#FFB300"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#E65100"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="beak-pouch" cx="40%" cy="30%" r="70%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFCA28"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#FF7043"/>
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#D84315"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#8D2B0B"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="leg-front" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFB74D"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#FB8C00"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B23C17"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="leg-back" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#E65100"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#872B00"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Cap & Scarf Gradients -->
    <radialGradient id="cap-dome" cx="40%" cy="30%" r="65%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#64B5F6"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#1E88E5"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0D47A1"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="scarf" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF5252"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#D32F2F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#7F0000"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Bicycle Gradients -->
    <linearGradient id="frame-red" x1="0.2" y1="0" x2="0.8" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF6B6B"/>
      <stop offset="35%" stop-color="#E53935"/>
      <stop offset="85%" stop-color="#8E0000"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B71C1C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="chrome" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="25%" stop-color="#B0BEC5"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#FFFFFF"/>
      <stop offset="75%" stop-color="#607D8B"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#CFD8DC"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="tire-grad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="78%" stop-color="#111"/>
      <stop offset="88%" stop-color="#455A64"/>
      <stop offset="95%" stop-color="#263238"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#111"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="leather" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#8D6E63"/>
      <stop offset="40%" stop-color="#5D4037"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#271815"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="basket-grad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0.5">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFE082"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#CA9A4B"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#795548"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Soft Shadow Filter -->
    <filter id="drop-shadow" x="-10%" y="-10%" width="130%" height="130%">
      <feDropShadow dx="2" dy="4" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.28"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="ground-blur" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5"/>
    </filter>

    <!-- Reusable Wheel Component -->
    <g id="wheel">
      <!-- Spokes -->
      <g stroke="#B0BEC5" stroke-width="1.2">
        <line x1="-54" y1="0" x2="54" y2="0"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-54" x2="0" y2="54"/>
        <line x1="-38" y1="-38" x2="38" y2="38"/>
        <line x1="-38" y1="38" x2="38" y2="-38"/>
        <line x1="-50" y1="-21" x2="50" y2="21"/>
        <line x1="-21" y1="-50" x2="21" y2="50"/>
        <line x1="-50" y1="21" x2="50" y2="-21"/>
        <line x1="-21" y1="50" x2="21" y2="-50"/>
      </g>
      <!-- Inner Metallic Rim -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="46" fill="none" stroke="url(#chrome)" stroke-width="4"/>
      <!-- Whitewall -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="49" fill="none" stroke="#FFF9E6" stroke-width="3.5"/>
      <!-- Rubber Tire with 3D Shading -->
      <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="55" fill="none" stroke="url(#tire-grad)" stroke-width="10"/>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <!-- 1. BACKGROUND -->
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <!-- Sun & Clouds -->
  <circle cx="65" cy="65" r="32" fill="#FFFDE7" opacity="0.9"/>
  <g fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.85">
    <path d="M 40 110 Q 55 95 75 105 Q 95 85 120 100 Q 140 95 145 110 Z"/>
    <path d="M 270 75 Q 290 55 315 68 Q 340 55 355 75 Z"/>
  </g>
  <!-- Distant Gull -->
  <path d="M 180 60 Q 188 52 195 60 Q 202 52 210 60" fill="none" stroke="#78909C" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Ocean Horizon -->
  <rect y="275" width="400" height="30" fill="url(#sea)"/>
  <path d="M 0 282 Q 100 280 200 282 T 400 281" fill="none" stroke="#90CAF9" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Boardwalk / Sandy Road -->
  <rect y="295" width="400" height="105" fill="url(#road)"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="295" x2="400" y2="295" stroke="#FFF" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Wooden Railing Posts (Behind Bike) -->
  <g fill="#8D6E63" stroke="#5D4037" stroke-width="1">
    <rect x="35" y="258" width="10" height="40" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="145" y="258" width="10" height="40" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="255" y="258" width="10" height="40" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="365" y="258" width="10" height="40" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="0" y="268" width="400" height="5" fill="#A1887F" stroke="none"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 2. GROUND SHADOWS (Crucial for 3D grounding) -->
  <g filter="url(#ground-blur)" fill="#3E2723" opacity="0.45">
    <ellipse cx="105" cy="363" rx="48" ry="8"/>
    <ellipse cx="295" cy="363" rx="48" ry="8"/>
    <ellipse cx="198" cy="358" rx="75" ry="14"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 3. BACK LAYER: PELICAN'S RIGHT SIDE (Behind Bicycle) -->
  <g id="back-side">
    <!-- Far Wing -->
    <path d="M 155 150 C 195 135, 240 165, 252 198 C 230 202, 195 190, 165 175 Z" fill="url(#pelican-back-wing)"/>
    <!-- Far Crank & Pedal (Up position) -->
    <line x1="185" y1="305" x2="173" y2="270" stroke="#78909C" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Far Leg & Webbed Foot -->
    <path d="M 162 215 L 142 248 L 173 268" fill="none" stroke="url(#leg-back)" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="M 165 268 L 192 263 L 186 274 L 164 273 Z" fill="url(#leg-back)"/>
    <rect x="163" y="267" width="22" height="7" rx="3" fill="#263238"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 4. BICYCLE: WHEELS & FRAME -->
  <!-- Rear Wheel -->
  <g transform="translate(105, 305)">
    <use href="#wheel"/>
    <!-- Rear Fender -->
    <path d="M -60 -15 A 62 62 0 0 1 55 -28" fill="none" stroke="url(#frame-red)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Front Wheel -->
  <g transform="translate(295, 305)">
    <use href="#wheel"/>
    <!-- Front Fender -->
    <path d="M -56 -26 A 62 62 0 0 1 58 -15" fill="none" stroke="url(#frame-red)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bicycle Frame (3D Tubular Shading + Drop Shadow) -->
  <g filter="url(#drop-shadow)">
    <!-- Rear Stays -->
    <line x1="105" y1="305" x2="185" y2="305" stroke="url(#frame-red)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="105" y1="305" x2="148" y2="218" stroke="url(#frame-red)" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Seat Tube -->
    <line x1="185" y1="305" x2="142" y2="202" stroke="url(#frame-red)" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Down Tube (Curved cruiser style) -->
    <path d="M 185 305 C 215 295, 240 245, 253 195" fill="none" stroke="url(#frame-red)" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Top Tube (Swept Cruiser Bar) -->
    <path d="M 146 215 C 185 232, 220 218, 250 183" fill="none" stroke="url(#frame-red)" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Head Tube -->
    <line x1="247" y1="173" x2="256" y2="202" stroke="url(#frame-red)" stroke-width="11" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="247" y1="173" x2="256" y2="202" stroke="url(#chrome)" stroke-width="11" stroke-dasharray="3 24" stroke-linecap="butt"/>
    <!-- Front Fork -->
    <path d="M 254 198 C 266 245, 278 278, 295 305" fill="none" stroke="url(#frame-red)" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Wheel Hubs (Caps over frame ends) -->
    <circle cx="105" cy="305" r="8" fill="url(#chrome)"/>
    <circle cx="105" cy="305" r="3" fill="#37474F"/>
    <circle cx="295" cy="305" r="8" fill="url(#chrome)"/>
    <circle cx="295" cy="305" r="3" fill="#37474F"/>

    <!-- Seat Post & Leather Saddle -->
    <line x1="142" y1="202" x2="136" y2="185" stroke="url(#chrome)" stroke-width="6"/>
    <path d="M 110 182 C 110 172, 130 175, 162 182 C 168 184, 164 193, 148 193 C 130 193, 110 192, 110 182 Z" fill="url(#leather)"/>
    <!-- Saddle Springs -->
    <path d="M 122 190 C 118 197, 128 197, 124 202" fill="none" stroke="url(#chrome)" stroke-width="2.5"/>

    <!-- Handlebar Stem (Back portion) -->
    <path d="M 247 173 L 238 140 C 236 132, 228 130, 215 138" fill="none" stroke="url(#chrome)" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Far Handlebar Grip -->
    <line x1="215" y1="138" x2="198" y2="144" stroke="url(#leather)" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    
    <!-- Wicker Basket & Fish on Front -->
    <g transform="translate(256, 142) rotate(12)">
      <!-- Fish Tail sticking out -->
      <path d="M 18 2 C 25 -15, 38 -18, 42 -22 C 38 -10, 36 -5, 45 2 C 34 2, 28 -2, 22 5 Z" fill="#4DD0E1" stroke="#00838F" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <!-- Basket Straps -->
      <rect x="-4" y="8" width="6" height="22" rx="2" fill="url(#leather)"/>
      <!-- Basket Body -->
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="36" height="32" rx="5" fill="url(#basket-grad)"/>
      <!-- Weave Texture -->
      <path d="M 2 8 L 34 8 M 2 16 L 34 16 M 2 24 L 34 24 M 12 2 L 12 30 M 24 2 L 24 30" stroke="#5D4037" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.45"/>
      <!-- Basket Rim -->
      <rect x="-2" y="-2" width="40" height="6" rx="3" fill="url(#basket-grad)" stroke="#795548" stroke-width="0.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- 5. PELICAN: TORSO, HEAD, BEAK & NEAR LEG -->
  <g id="pelican-main" filter="url(#drop-shadow)">
    <!-- Tail Feathers -->
    <path d="M 105 182 L 80 172 L 90 164 L 76 153 L 112 158 Z" fill="url(#pelican-body)" stroke="#B0C4DE" stroke-width="1"/>
    
    <!-- Plump Body -->
    <path d="M 105 172 C 95 142, 130 118, 165 132 C 195 142, 205 180, 185 208 C 165 232, 122 222, 112 190 Z" fill="url(#pelican-body)"/>

    <!-- Near Thigh (Feathered) -->
    <path d="M 142 195 C 138 220, 158 228, 168 212 Z" fill="url(#pelican-body)"/>

    <!-- Drivetrain (Chainring & Chain - behind near foot, in front of frame) -->
    <path d="M 105 299 L 185 291 L 185 319 L 105 311 Z" fill="none" stroke="#37474F" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-dasharray="4 2"/>
    <circle cx="185" cy="305" r="16" fill="url(#chrome)" stroke="#455A64" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="185" cy="305" r="11" fill="none" stroke="#263238" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>

    <!-- Near Crank Arm (Down position) -->
    <line x1="185" y1="305" x2="198" y2="342" stroke="url(#chrome)" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Near Leg (Orange, bent knee) -->
    <path d="M 154 214 L 182 268 L 196 336" fill="none" stroke="url(#leg-front)" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- Knee Highlight -->
    <circle cx="182" cy="268" r="4" fill="#FFE082" opacity="0.5"/>
    <!-- Big Webbed Near Foot -->
    <path d="M 188 334 L 224 332 C 228 338, 220 345, 212 346 L 185 342 Z" fill="url(#leg-front)"/>
    <path d="M 192 335 L 220 335 M 192 338 L 216 341" stroke="#FFE082" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Near Pedal -->
    <rect x="184" y="340" width="28" height="7" rx="3" fill="#263238" stroke="url(#chrome)" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="190" y="342" width="16" height="3" fill="#FF8F00"/>

    <!-- S-Curved Neck & Head -->
    <path d="M 162 152 C 188 152, 194 115, 182 90 C 172 68, 178 44, 198 44 C 218 44, 228 58, 224 76 C 218 96, 198 92, 206 118 C 214 142, 202 182, 174 182 Z" fill="url(#pelican-neck)"/>

    <!-- Cheek Blush -->
    <ellipse cx="212" cy="70" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.55"/>

    <!-- Expressive Eye -->
    <circle cx="209" cy="58" r="7.5" fill="#FFF9C4" stroke="#B0BEC5" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="211" cy="58" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="213" cy="58" r="3" fill="#1A237E"/>
    <circle cx="214" cy="56.5" r="1.3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <!-- Cheerful Eyebrow Ridge -->
    <path d="M 201 52 Q 210 47 217 53" fill="none" stroke="#D0DCE8" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- GIANT PELICAN BEAK (3D layered pouch & upper mandible) -->
    <!-- Throat Pouch -->
    <path d="M 214 72 C 216 122, 265 132, 315 86 C 322 80, 328 74, 330 70 C 290 73, 248 73, 214 72 Z" fill="url(#beak-pouch)"/>
    <!-- Pouch 3D Crease Lines -->
    <path d="M 222 82 C 245 104, 280 100, 315 78" fill="none" stroke="#BF360C" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.45"/>
    <path d="M 230 94 C 252 112, 278 106, 305 84" fill="none" stroke="#FFCC80" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.4"/>
    
    <!-- Upper Mandible (Top Beak) -->
    <path d="M 220 53 C 258 51, 305 55, 334 64 C 338 66, 338 73, 332 76 C 329 77, 327 72, 324 72 C 285 75, 245 75, 213 73 Z" fill="url(#beak-top)"/>
    <!-- Beak Top Highlight -->
    <path d="M 225 57 C 260 56, 300 59, 328 66" fill="none" stroke="#FFF59D" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>

    <!-- Jaunty Sailor / Cycling Cap -->
    <g transform="translate(194, 42) rotate(-14)">
      <!-- Cap Visor -->
      <path d="M 12 4 C 24 2, 35 6, 37 11 C 28 14, 18 12, 8 8 Z" fill="#1A237E"/>
      <!-- Cap Dome -->
      <path d="M -10 8 C -12 -10, 18 -14, 24 5 C 14 9, -2 9, -10 8 Z" fill="url(#cap-dome)"/>
      <!-- Cap Band & Button -->
      <path d="M -9 6 C 2 8, 14 7, 23 4" fill="none" stroke="#FFCA28" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <circle cx="6" cy="-6" r="2.5" fill="#FFCA28"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Red Scarf Blowing in the Wind -->
    <g>
      <!-- Tails fluttering back -->
      <path d="M 182 128 C 145 120, 112 102, 78 112 C 92 124, 82 134, 68 136 C 108 144, 145 140, 180 142 Z" fill="url(#scarf)"/>
      <!-- Scarf Stripes -->
      <path d="M 92 115 L 86 135 M 115 117 L 110 137" stroke="#FFCDD2" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.7"/>
      <!-- Neck Wrap -->
      <path d="M 174 125 C 188 124, 206 128, 208 136 C 206 145, 184 146, 174 138 Z" fill="url(#scarf)"/>
      <!-- Scarf Knot -->
      <ellipse cx="180" cy="136" rx="8" ry="10" fill="url(#scarf)" stroke="#8E0000" stroke-width="1"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- 6. FOREGROUND LAYER: NEAR HANDLEBAR & PELICAN'S LEFT WING -->
  <g id="foreground-arm" filter="url(#drop-shadow)">
    <!-- Near Handlebar Sweep (Comes toward viewer) -->
    <path d="M 238 140 C 242 152, 232 168, 208 168" fill="none" stroke="url(#chrome)" stroke-width="6.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Bicycle Bell -->
    <ellipse cx="226" cy="160" rx="6" ry="5" fill="url(#chrome)"/>
    <path d="M 222 160 L 230 160" stroke="#455A64" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Near Leather Grip -->
    <line x1="212" y1="168" x2="190" y2="168" stroke="url(#leather)" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="190" cy="168" r="5" fill="url(#chrome)"/>

    <!-- Pelican's Near Wing (Reaching to grip the handlebar) -->
    <path d="M 142 152 C 122 164, 130 202, 165 196 C 185 192, 198 184, 210 174 C 216 168, 210 156, 198 160 C 184 164, 168 140, 142 152 Z" fill="url(#pelican-wing)"/>
    
    <!-- Wing Feather Details & Highlights -->
    <path d="M 145 178 C 165 184, 185 180, 202 170" fill="none" stroke="#9BAEC8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M 152 188 C 170 192, 188 186, 205 174" fill="none" stroke="#9BAEC8" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Wing-tip "Fingers" curled over the grip -->
    <path d="M 195 162 C 204 158, 214 164, 208 174 C 202 178, 194 174, 196 168" fill="url(#pelican-wing)" stroke="#8A9FB4" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 7. MOTION & ATMOSPHERE DETAILS -->
  <g stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.65">
    <line x1="25" y1="125" x2="55" y2="125"/>
    <line x1="15" y1="145" x2="40" y2="145"/>
    <line x1="28" y1="305" x2="45" y2="305"/>
    <line x1="18" y1="325" x2="48" y2="325"/>
  </g>
</svg>
